info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Enterprise Services Internal Audit Review-v5-spec
info.description: The Internal Audit Review Submission API enables organizations to initiate and manage reviews associated with internal audits for banking enterprise services. This endpoint allows users to submit detailed review information linked to a specific internal audit identified by its ID. Typically utilized by auditors, compliance teams, and financial institutions, this API streamlines the review process, facilitating better tracking and management of audit assessments. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance their internal audit procedures, improving compliance and overall operational efficiency.

post.summary: Create a review for an internal audit resource.
post.description: This operation allows you to create a review for the specific internal audit resource identified by RES-100045. Use this endpoint to submit your review and feedback for the audit process, which can help improve future audits and ensure compliance and quality.
